metricSemantics.actionLatencyMs: Elapsed wall time from action start until the explicit readiness oracle passes; no artificial observation delay is included.
metricSemantics.observationWindowMs: A separate fixed window used for frame pacing, long tasks, React commits, and post-readiness CDP counter deltas.
metricSemantics.resources: Resource timing is cleared at each phase boundary and filtered to entries whose startTime falls inside the in-page measurement bounds.
metricSemantics.cdpWindowMs: CDP counter deltas use their own Performance.Timestamp interval. This may exceed the fixed in-page observation window when main-thread work delays the protocol capture.
metricSemantics.webgl: activeContexts counts connected, non-lost WebGL contexts at observation end. totalContextsCreated is cumulative and is never used as the active-renderer assertion.
